title: HSK 3.20 · 创业, 家乡, 开展, 年底
focus: 访问 · 玩具 · 从事 · 创作 · 去世 · 高速 · 属 · 跳舞 · 电视台 · 家具 · 家乡 · 创新 · 提问 · 家属 · 从前 · 写作 · 本事 · 高速公路 · 底下 · 开展 · 前后 · 解开 · 一方面 · 搬家 · 开业 · 就业 · 公务员 · 世界杯 · 故乡 · 推开 · 初级 · 班级 · 创业 · 本领 · 年底 · 年初 · 初一 · 跳高 · 跳远 · 后年
body:
Home, work and starting things: 家 gives furniture, hometown and family, 创 "create" and 业 "business" combine into 创业 start-up, and 初/底 mark the start and bottom (end) of a year.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 家 | jiā | home, family (宀 roof + 豕 pig) | 家具, 家乡, 家属, 搬家 |
| 创 | chuàng | create, start (刂 knife + 仓 phonetic) | 创作, 创新, 创业 |
| 开 | kāi | open | 开展, 解开, 开业, 推开 |
| 跳 | tiào | jump (⻊ foot + 兆 zhào phonetic) | 跳舞, 跳高, 跳远 |
| 业 | yè | trade, business, career | 开业, 就业, 创业 |
| 初 | chū | beginning | 初级, 年初, 初一 |
| 底 | dǐ | bottom, end (广 + 氐 dǐ phonetic) | 底下, 年底 |
| 本 | běn | root (木 tree + a mark at its root) | 本事, 本领 |

## Watch out

- 本事 and 底下 have light second syllables: běnshi, dǐxia.
- 底 bottom (广 roof) vs 低 low (亻 person): same sound part 氐, different radical.

cards.Example: 记者访问了他。 jìzhě fǎngwèn le tā: a reporter interviewed him
cards.Notes: 访 visit (讠 speech + 方 fāng phonetic) + 问 ask = call on and ask, visit

cards.Example: 孩子有很多玩具。 háizi yǒu hěn duō wánjù: the kid has lots of toys
cards.Notes: 玩 play + 具 tool, utensil = plaything

cards.Example: 他从事教育工作。 tā cóngshì jiàoyù gōngzuò: he works in education
cards.Notes: 从 follow + 事 matter, job = follow a line of work

cards.Example: 他在创作新歌。 tā zài chuàngzuò xīn gē: he's writing a new song
cards.Notes: 创 create + 作 make, work = create artistic work

cards.Example: 他爷爷去世了。 tā yéye qùshì le: his grandpa passed away
cards.Notes: 去 leave + 世 world = leave the world (polite for 'die')

cards.Example: 我们走高速吧。 wǒmen zǒu gāosù ba: let's take the expressway
cards.Notes: 高 high + 速 speed (辶 movement) = high speed

cards.Meaning: to belong to; to be born in year of
cards.Example: 我属马。 wǒ shǔ mǎ: I was born in the Year of the Horse
cards.Notes: 属 = 尸 + 禹, simplified from 屬 where 蜀 shǔ gave the sound; used for belonging and zodiac signs

cards.Example: 我们去跳舞吧。 wǒmen qù tiàowǔ ba: let's go dancing
cards.Notes: 跳 jump (⻊ foot + 兆 zhào phonetic) + 舞 dance = dance

cards.Example: 她在电视台工作。 tā zài diànshìtái gōngzuò: she works at a TV station
cards.Notes: 电视 TV (电 electric + 视 view) + 台 station, platform

cards.Example: 我们买了新家具。 wǒmen mǎi le xīn jiājù: we bought new furniture
cards.Notes: 家 home + 具 utensil, tool = home equipment, furniture

cards.Example: 我很想家乡。 wǒ hěn xiǎng jiāxiāng: I miss my hometown
cards.Notes: 家 home + 乡 village, countryside = home village

cards.Example: 公司需要创新。 gōngsī xūyào chuàngxīn: the company needs innovation
cards.Notes: 创 create + 新 new = create the new

cards.Example: 有问题可以提问。 yǒu wèntí kěyǐ tíwèn: you can ask if you have questions
cards.Notes: 提 raise, lift (扌 hand) + 问 ask = raise a question

cards.Example: 家属请在外面等。 jiāshǔ qǐng zài wàimiàn děng: family please wait outside
cards.Notes: 家 family + 属 belong = those belonging to the family

cards.Meaning: in the past; once upon a time
cards.Example: 从前有一座山。 cóngqián yǒu yí zuò shān: once upon a time there was a mountain
cards.Notes: 从 from + 前 before = from before, formerly

cards.Example: 她喜欢写作。 tā xǐhuan xiězuò: she likes writing
cards.Notes: 写 write + 作 make, compose = compose writing

cards.Example: 你真有本事！ nǐ zhēn yǒu běnshi: you're really capable!
cards.Notes: 本 root, one's own + 事 matter = what one can do oneself; second syllable light

cards.Example: 高速公路上车很多。 gāosù gōnglù shang chē hěn duō: the highway is busy
cards.Notes: 高速 high-speed + 公路 public road = expressway

cards.Example: 猫在桌子底下。 māo zài zhuōzi dǐxia: the cat is under the table
cards.Notes: 底 bottom + 下 below = underneath

cards.Example: 学校开展了活动。 xuéxiào kāizhǎn le huódòng: the school launched an activity
cards.Notes: 开 open + 展 unfold, spread = open up and roll out

cards.Example: 春节前后很忙。 Chūnjié qiánhòu hěn máng: it's busy around Spring Festival
cards.Notes: 前 before + 后 after = before and after, around

cards.Example: 请解开这个绳子。 qǐng jiěkāi zhège shéngzi: please untie this rope
cards.Notes: 解 untie (角 horn + 刀 knife + 牛 ox: carving an ox) + 开 open = undo

cards.Example: 一方面便宜，一方面好看。 yì fāngmiàn piányi, yì fāngmiàn hǎokàn: it's cheap, and also pretty
cards.Notes: 一 one + 方面 side, aspect (方 side + 面 face) = on one side

cards.Example: 我们下个月搬家。 wǒmen xià ge yuè bānjiā: we move next month
cards.Notes: 搬 move, carry (扌 hand + 般 bān phonetic) + 家 home

cards.Example: 这家店刚开业。 zhè jiā diàn gāng kāiyè: this shop just opened
cards.Notes: 开 open + 业 business

cards.Example: 毕业以后就业难。 bìyè yǐhòu jiùyè nán: finding jobs after graduation is hard
cards.Notes: 就 take up + 业 work = take up work

cards.Example: 他想当公务员。 tā xiǎng dāng gōngwùyuán: he wants to be a civil servant
cards.Notes: 公 public + 务 affairs + 员 member = public-affairs staff

cards.Example: 你看世界杯吗？ nǐ kàn Shìjièbēi ma: do you watch the World Cup?
cards.Notes: 世界 world + 杯 cup (木 wood + 不 bù phonetic)

cards.Example: 我想回故乡。 wǒ xiǎng huí gùxiāng: I want to go back home
cards.Notes: 故 old, former + 乡 village = old home; more literary than 家乡

cards.Example: 他推开了门。 tā tuīkāi le mén: he pushed the door open
cards.Notes: 推 push + 开 open = push open

cards.Example: 我在上初级班。 wǒ zài shàng chūjí bān: I'm in the beginner class
cards.Notes: 初 beginning + 级 level (纟 + 及 jí phonetic) = first level

cards.Example: 我们班级很团结。 wǒmen bānjí hěn tuánjié: our class sticks together
cards.Notes: 班 class, group + 级 grade = a school class

cards.Example: 他毕业后去创业。 tā bìyè hòu qù chuàngyè: he started a business after graduating
cards.Notes: 创 create + 业 business = found an enterprise

cards.Example: 他本领很大。 tā běnlǐng hěn dà: he's very skilled
cards.Notes: 本 root, one's own + 领 grasp, lead = one's own abilities

cards.Example: 年底很忙。 niándǐ hěn máng: year-end is busy
cards.Notes: 年 year + 底 bottom = the bottom (end) of the year

cards.Example: 他年初结婚了。 tā niánchū jiéhūn le: he got married early this year
cards.Notes: 年 year + 初 beginning = start of the year

cards.Example: 大年初一吃饺子。 dànián chūyī chī jiǎozi: eat dumplings on New Year's Day
cards.Notes: 初 beginning + 一 one = the first (day); also first year of junior high

cards.Example: 他跳高很好。 tā tiàogāo hěn hǎo: he's good at high jump
cards.Notes: 跳 jump + 高 high = high jump

cards.Example: 我喜欢跳远。 wǒ xǐhuan tiàoyuǎn: I like the long jump
cards.Notes: 跳 jump + 远 far = long jump

cards.Example: 我后年毕业。 wǒ hòunián bìyè: I graduate the year after next
cards.Notes: 后 after + 年 year = after next year
